ArchiFAQ1.description: Find answers to common questions about our design process, services and working approach.

items.question: 1. What services does your design studio offer?
items.answer: We offer a complete range of architectural and interior design services including residential, commercial, office spaces, renovations and turnkey project solutions tailored to your needs.

items.question: 2. How does the design process work?
items.answer: Our design process starts with client discovery, feasibility study, schematic plans, 3D renderings, and ends with hands-on site management.

items.question: 3. Do you provide customized designs?
items.answer: Yes, every layout, bespoke cabinetry piece, and lighting plan is tailored to individual requirements.

items.question: 4. What is the typical project timeline?
items.answer: Interior renovations usually span 8-12 weeks, whereas full-scale architectural builds can take anywhere between 6-18 months.

items.question: 5. Do you handle both design and execution?
items.answer: Yes, we handle complete turnkey execution, supervising contractors and materials on-site.

items.question: 6. What factors affect the project cost?
items.answer: Scope of work, structural complexity, selected materials, and custom finishes determine final expenses.

items.question: 7. Can you work with my existing space?
items.answer: Yes, we specialize in structural renovations and internal space restructuring.

items.question: 8. do you offer 3d designs or visualization?
items.answer: Yes, photo-realistic 3D rendering and VR walkthroughs are part of our standard design package.

items.question: 9. Will you help with material selection?
items.answer: Yes, our team personally accompanies clients to showrooms to pick finishes, veneers, and stones.

items.question: 10. Do you provide after-service support?
items.answer: Yes, we provide warranty assistance and scheduled follow-ups post handover.
